identity.identity_note: Reference electrical configuration in the Smooth2 software profile only; this is not confirmation of the user's physical battery pack.

simulation_policy.state_of_charge: estimated from model-based electrical current only
simulation_policy.current_estimate: derived from configured rotor torque proxy and an optimistic motor efficiency ceiling; excludes no-load, copper, ESC and wiring losses
simulation_policy.physical_use: not suitable for battery sizing, flight-time prediction, current-limit selection or real-flight operation

required_measurements: exact pack label and cell count
loaded pack voltage during representative current draw
pack internal resistance using a documented method
